summary: If someone says he will be a nazir from dried figs, Beis Shammai and Beis Hillel argue whether he becomes a nazir.

chunks.explain: His extra words about figs don't count.
chunks.st: Beit Shammai say: His statement renders him a full-fledged nazirite,
chunks.stMore: and his addition: From dried figs, is insignificant, as this fruit is not included in the prohibitions of a nazirite, which include only products of the grapevine.

chunks.en: But Beis Hillel say
chunks.st: And Beit Hillel say:

chunks.en: he is not a nazir.
chunks.st: He is not a nazirite,
chunks.stMore: since he did not accept naziriteship upon himself.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yehudah said,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda said:

chunks.en: they said it only about someone who means,
chunks.st: they said that only in a case where one said that he meant:

chunks.en: "These figs are forbidden to me like a korban."
chunks.explain: Then the figs are forbidden to him, but he is not a nazir.
chunks.st: They are hereby forbidden to me as an offering.
chunks.stMore: In that case it is as though he took a vow rendering the figs forbidden to him. However, Beit Shammai concede that although the vow takes effect, it is not a vow of naziriteship.

summary: If someone says, "I am a nazir from this cup of wine," he becomes a full nazir. But the Sages said that one woman who was drunk only meant that this cup was forbidden to her.

chunks.en: If they poured him a cup of wine,
chunks.st: If they poured one a cup of wine

chunks.st: he is a full-fledged nazirite

summary: Someone says he will be a nazir and also pay for another nazir's korbanos, and his friend says "me too." If they are smart, they pay for each other's korbanos.

chunks.en: If he says, "I am a nazir, and I must pay for a nazir's shaving,"

summary: Someone said he would be a nazir for a hundred days, and also a nazir when he has a son. If the son is born after day seventy, he loses those seventy days, because a nazir cannot shave after less than thirty days.

chunks.en: If he says, "I will be a nazir when I have a son,
chunks.st: In the case of one who said: I am hereby a nazirite when I will have a son,

chunks.st: However, if his son is born after seventy days,

chunks.en: those seventy days are undone,

chunks.stMore: and he must observe a full hundred days after he completes the naziriteship for his son. The reason is that here, he is unable to merely complete the remaining days of his initial naziriteship after shaving at the completion of the naziriteship for his son,

chunks.en: because there is no shaving after less than thirty days.
chunks.explain: After his son's nezirus, fewer than thirty days would be left.
chunks.st: since shaving cannot be performed after a period of less than thirty days.
